content.short: Hash0x provides decentralised cross-chain swaps for Ethereum and EVM tokens.
content.description: Cross-chain payments and token transfers remain hard to do quickly, cheaply, and safely. Hash0x sits within a broader product suite designed to help users pay and move tokens across networks. By weaving crypto payments into everyday business workflows, this solution aims to simplify crypto payments for small businesses—especially web3 companies, freelancers, and charities—so cross-chain transactions become a routine part of operations rather than a separate task.
